messages:
Rina (People Ops): Follow-up thread from today's all-hands Q&A. Drop short questions about reviews/promos/benefits and we'll answer here. If it's confidential, DM me.

Ana (Eng): If someone gets promoted off-cycle due to a missed calibration, when does salary change take effect?

Jamal (Finance): Effective date is the approval date on the off-cycle form. Pay change processed in the next payroll cycle after approvals are complete.

Marcus (Manager): Is there a hard cutoff for submitting off-cycle forms before year-end comp planning?

Rina (People Ops): For year-end comp planning, submit off-cycle requests at least 21 days before the comp committee cutover. Exceptions are rare.

Ana (Eng): Parental top-up: does it apply if someone takes intermittent leave?

Rina (People Ops): Intermittent leave is reviewed case-by-case; top-up generally applies to continuous parental leave. DM details and we'll confirm.

Marcus (Manager): Minor: are managers allowed to share the anonymized calibration summary with direct reports?

Rina (People Ops): No  calibration artifacts shared with ICs. Managers should summarize outcomes in 1:1s without sharing raw distributions.

PeopleOpsBot: Manager toolkit updated: /handbook/manager-toolkit (edited 1789990150).

Rina (People Ops): Thanks all  we'll post an FAQ doc in the all-hands folder tomorrow.
